title: Does Size Still Matter
summary: What is the outlook for VLCC demand in the coming years? For many years, VLCCs have been regarded as the "bellwether" of the tanker market. Improvements in the market would frequently start with VLCCs and given their dominant position in the Middle East crude oil export trades, the fortunes of OPEC and the VLCC market would often be tied.
